instruction.text: Bilde die Fragen im present perfect progressive.
instruction.sound: Bilde die Fragen im <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>present perfect progressive</voice>

hint.text: Fragen beginnen oft mit einem Fragewort, wie z.B. who/what/how. In Fragen steht außerdem have/has vor dem Subjekt, z.B. “Have you been listening?“, “What have you been doing?”.
hint.sound: Fragen beginnen oft mit einem Fragewort, wie z.B. <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>who, what, how</voice> In Fragen steht außerdem <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>have</voice> oder <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>has</voice> vor dem Subjekt, z.B. <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>Have you been listening?</voice> <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>What have you been doing?</voice>

instruction.text: Setze aus den gegebenen Wörtern eine passende Antwort auf die Frage zusammen. Achte dabei auf die richtige Zeichensetzung.

atoms.a: Have you been taking notes for the last 30 minutes?
atoms.sound: Have you been taking notes for the last 30 minutes?

atoms.a: Have you been sleeping well since you've had the new bed?
atoms.sound: Have you been sleeping well since you have the new bed?

hint.text: Für die Lösung werden nicht alle Wörter benötigt. Du kannst die Kurz- oder Langform verwenden.

atoms.a: Who have you been calling every day for the last two weeks?
atoms.sound: Who have you been calling every day for the last two weeks?

atoms.a: What have you been doing after school since you broke your leg?
atoms.sound: What have you been doing after school since you broke your leg?

atoms.a: What kind of films have you been watching lately?
atoms.sound: What kind of films have you been watching lately?

instruction.text: Schreibe die Verneinung in die Lücke. Du kannst die Kurz- oder Langform verwenden.

atoms.b: I ((haven't have_not)) been listening for the last ten minutes.
She ((hasn't has_not)) been sleeping well for the past few days.
We ((haven't have_not)) been going to any parties since Halloween.
He ((hasn't has_not)) been drinking milk since he got sick.
